items.instructions: Take after meals if temperature > 99.5 F or bodyache occurs. Max 8 tabs/day.

prescriptionTemplates.tests_advised: Complete Blood Count (CBC) with Platelets, Dengue NS1 (if high continuous fever)
prescriptionTemplates.advice: Drink 2.5 - 3 liters of warm water & soups daily. Cold sponging if temp > 102 F. Complete rest.
